design.name: 大鹗
design.brief: Da'e (大鹗), the Great Osprey of the Shan Hai Jing's Western Mountains: on Bell Mountain the god Qinpi (钦䲹) was executed for murder and changed into a great osprey, 'shaped like an eagle with black markings and a white head, a red beak and TIGER CLAWS; wherever it appears there is war'. Woken by the thunderstorms it nests on a river cliff above a gorge with an iron-chain bridge. A colossal eagle-like raptor about 5 m from beak to tail tip with a 16 m wingspan (NOT a Western griffin, no lion body, no fur on the body): a snow-white feathered HEAD and neck ruff with a heavy scowling brow and a huge hooked CRIMSON-RED beak; soot-black and dark umber body feathers with bold cream-white bar markings (the 'black markings') in big carved feather plates; huge broad eagle wings, black primaries with cream-white bands; a wide fan tail of long black-and-white barred feathers. Its LEGS are TIGER legs from the feathered thighs down: thick orange-ochre fur with black tiger stripes ending in big TIGER PAWS with four toes and long black hooked claws (no bird feet, no scaly bird toes). Magenta-violet thunder veins run over the chest and along the wing roots; a glowing magenta core sits in the middle of the chest feathers (weak spot) and both wing roots glow (weak spots). Majestic, predatory, ancient.
design.role: 4-2 领主 · 大渡河铁索桥峡谷（江嘴鹗巢）
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.note: 2026-10-23 新增（4-2 领主，chuanzang-v1.md 3.5 / chuanzang-combat-v1.md 4.4）；正式模型走 Tripo，骨架翼骨三节 + 头颈 + 虎腿虎爪
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright on BOTH tiger legs with the two tiger paws flat on the ground side by side, the body upright like a perched eagle; both huge wings raised and spread UP and OUT in a wide V like a heraldic eagle, fully open with every long primary feather separated and visible, the wing leading edges straight; the fan tail spread and hanging straight down behind the legs to the ground; the white head facing straight ahead with the red beak closed; MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding feathers or scales, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour; the chest core and the wing-root weak spots are flat painted magenta-violet patches
design.turnaround_digits: each tiger paw with four separate toes and black hooked claws clearly visible; exactly two wings, two legs and one tail fan; both wingtips, the tail fan and the paws fully inside the frame.

generation.note: Tripo Studio 出图（本机 Codex 出图 403）。第一次用流水线原文（带第四章背景），Tripo 的模型把夔画了出来，弃用；这一版只写大鹗。画面上有标题和标签文字（提示词禁了也照样画），只当四视图的参考
